note: frame k (1-based) shows t = t0 + (k-1)/fps; null = behind the camera

keys.route: the fleet water path (every 3rd point, harbour mouth → mainland coast)
keys.coast: mainland coast the fleet heads for
keys.town_east: east part of the town (stays in frame; the centre leaves it on the left after ~48 s)
keys.harbor_lobe: flows.json harbor_lobe path (vent → front_stop), for a crisp DOM arrow «toward the harbour»
keys.cloud: QA: screen bbox [x0, y0, x1, y1] of the eruption cloud (null before it exists)
